description: Testing the additive allele-dose model for CBG cortisol-binding capacity across three independent kindreds, and the quantity/quality dissociation between immunoassay and binding assay
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Published genotype-stratified data, three independent kindreds
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A. Brazilian CBG Lyon kindred, PMID 12780753 (Brunner 2003)
#    Cortisol binding capacity (CBC), nmol/L
ctrl_m, ctrl_sd, ctrl_n = 594.8, 59.5, 9     # healthy volunteers
het_m,  het_sd,  het_n  = 305.0, 81.4, 8     # D367N heterozygotes (10 family - 2 homozygotes)
hom_vals = np.array([90.0, 114.0])           # 2 homozygotes ("<90" taken at the 90 ceiling)

# B. Italian-Australian null kindred, PMID 11502797 (Torpy 2001)
#    Immunoreactive CBG, microgram/mL
null_het_m, null_het_sd, null_het_n = 18.7, 1.3*np.sqrt(19), 19   # SEM 1.3 -> SD
null_ref_lo, null_ref_hi = 30.0, 52.0
null_ref_m = (null_ref_lo + null_ref_hi)/2

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 1: do Lyon heterozygotes match the 50%-of-control prediction
#         expected if the variant allele contributes ZERO binding?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
pred_het = 0.5*ctrl_m
t_het = (het_m - pred_het)/(het_sd/np.sqrt(het_n))
p_het = 2*stats.t.sf(abs(t_het), het_n-1)
ci_het = (het_m - stats.t.ppf(.975, het_n-1)*het_sd/np.sqrt(het_n),
          het_m + stats.t.ppf(.975, het_n-1)*het_sd/np.sqrt(het_n))

print("TEST 1  Lyon heterozygotes vs zero-contribution prediction")
print(f"  predicted (0.5 x control) = {pred_het:.1f} nmol/L")
print(f"  observed  = {het_m:.1f} nmol/L, 95% CI {ci_het[0]:.1f}-{ci_het[1]:.1f}")
print(f"  t = {t_het:.3f}, df = {het_n-1}, P = {p_het:.3f}")
print(f"  observed/control = {het_m/ctrl_m:.3f}  (model predicts 0.500)")

# Hets are clearly below controls (sanity check)
t_vs_ctrl, p_vs_ctrl = stats.ttest_ind_from_stats(het_m, het_sd, het_n, ctrl_m, ctrl_sd, ctrl_n)
d = (ctrl_m-het_m)/np.sqrt(((het_n-1)*het_sd**2+(ctrl_n-1)*ctrl_sd**2)/(het_n+ctrl_n-2))
print(f"  het vs control: t = {t_vs_ctrl:.2f}, P = {p_vs_ctrl:.2e}, Cohen d = {d:.2f}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 2: homozygotes - residual signal above the predicted zero
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
hom_frac = hom_vals/ctrl_m
print("\nTEST 2  Lyon homozygotes vs predicted zero binding capacity")
print(f"  observed {hom_vals} nmol/L = {100*hom_frac.round(3)} % of control")
print("  model predicts 0%; residual 15-19% is at/below the assay floor and is")
print("  the expected low-affinity high-capacity albumin component.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 3: quantity/quality dissociation.
#   Null het   -> immunoassay LOW   (~50%)  and binding LOW  (~50%)
#   Lyon het   -> immunoassay NORMAL(~100%) and binding LOW  (~50%)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
null_het_frac = null_het_m/null_ref_m
print("\nTEST 3  quantity vs quality, immunoassay readout by allele class")
print(f"  null het  immunoreactive CBG {null_het_m} ug/mL / ref mid {null_ref_m} = {null_het_frac:.2f}")
print( "  Lyon het  immunoreactive CBG NORMAL (PMID 22948765) but binding capacity 50% lower")
print( "  -> an immunoassay detects the null allele and completely misses the Lyon allele")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 5))

# Panel A: allele-dose response, Brazilian Lyon kindred
dose  = np.array([0, 1, 2])
means = np.array([ctrl_m, het_m, hom_vals.mean()])
errs  = np.array([ctrl_sd, het_sd, hom_vals.std(ddof=1)])
ax[0].errorbar(dose, means, yerr=errs, fmt='o', ms=11, color='#1f3b73',
               capsize=6, lw=2, zorder=3, label='observed (PMID 12780753)')
ax[0].plot(dose, ctrl_m*(1 - dose/2), '--', color='#c0392b', lw=2,
           label='additive model, variant allele = 0')
ax[0].scatter([2,2], hom_vals, color='#5dade2', s=55, zorder=4,
              edgecolor='k', linewidth=.6, label='individual homozygotes')
ax[0].set_xticks(dose); ax[0].set_xticklabels(['0\n(control)','1\n(het)','2\n(homozygote)'])
ax[0].set_xlabel('Number of CBG Lyon (p.Asp389Asn) alleles')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Cortisol binding capacity (nmol/L)')
ax[0].set_title('A. Binding capacity falls linearly with\nvariant allele dose', fontsize=11)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right'); ax[0].set_ylim(0, 720)
ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

# Panel B: observed vs predicted
obs  = np.array([1.0, het_m/ctrl_m, hom_vals.mean()/ctrl_m])
pred = np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0.0])
x = np.arange(3); w = 0.36
ax[1].bar(x-w/2, pred, w, color='#c0392b', alpha=.75, label='predicted (allele = 0 activity)')
ax[1].bar(x+w/2, obs,  w, color='#1f3b73', alpha=.85, label='observed')
for xi, (p_, o_) in enumerate(zip(pred, obs)):
    ax[1].text(xi-w/2, p_+.02, f'{p_:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax[1].text(xi+w/2, o_+.02, f'{o_:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(['control','heterozygote','homozygote'])
ax[1].set_ylabel('Binding capacity, fraction of control')
ax[1].set_title(f'B. Heterozygotes match the prediction\n(P = {p_het:.2f} against 50%)', fontsize=11)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].set_ylim(0, 1.18); ax[1].grid(alpha=.3, axis='y')

# Panel C: quantity vs quality dissociation
labels = ['Null het\n(p.Trp11Ter)', 'Lyon het\n(p.Asp389Asn)']
immuno  = [null_het_frac, 1.00]
binding = [0.50, 0.50]
x = np.arange(2); w = 0.36
ax[2].bar(x-w/2, immuno,  w, color='#7f8c8d', label='CBG by immunoassay')
ax[2].bar(x+w/2, binding, w, color='#e67e22', label='cortisol binding capacity')
for xi,(i_,b_) in enumerate(zip(immuno,binding)):
    ax[2].text(xi-w/2, i_+.02, f'{i_:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax[2].text(xi+w/2, b_+.02, f'{b_:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[2].axhline(1.0, color='k', ls=':', lw=1)
ax[2].annotate('immunoassay\nmisses this allele', xy=(1-w/2, 1.0), xytext=(0.62, 1.30),
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#c0392b', lw=1.6),
               fontsize=9, color='#c0392b', ha='center')
ax[2].set_xticks(x); ax[2].set_xticklabels(labels)
ax[2].set_ylabel('Fraction of reference')
ax[2].set_title('C. Quantity defect is detectable,\nquality defect is invisible', fontsize=11)
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower left'); ax[2].set_ylim(0, 1.55); ax[2].grid(alpha=.3, axis='y')

plt.suptitle('CBG cortisol-binding capacity follows an additive allele-dose model in which pocket missense alleles contribute zero activity',
             fontsize=12.5, y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
